name: testfolio (testfol.io)
description: A free web-based portfolio backtester: compares asset allocations, models rebalancing and cashflows, and analyzes historical risk and return for ETF/ticker portfolios. Useful here as a design reference for backtest-style result presentation (equity curves, drawdown, rolling-return tables) rather than as a data feed.

notes: Basic backtesting works without an account. A free account (email sign-in) raises usage limits, adds cloud save of portfolios/strategies, and is required for some advanced tools (e.g. the Tactical Allocation tool, gated after reported API abuse).
The site is a client-rendered single-page app; a plain HTTP fetch of any page (including /terms) returns only the app shell, not the rendered content.

terms.summary: A Terms of Service page exists (testfol.io/terms) but renders client-side and could not be fetched as text, so no verbatim quote could be taken.
